note: Allowlist for the retrieval corpus. retriever.load_chunks() skips (with a loud warning) any data/parsed/*.jsonl file that is not listed here, or whose sha256 does not match. This is the permanent guard against synthetic/test fixtures (e.g. the lorem-ipsum 'fremont-council-2026-07-11-agenda' fixture, quarantined 2026-10-12) leaking into the live index.
